teaser: You close one tab, then open three more, then close those too — a 7 and an ENFP caught mid-search. The number is called the Seeker for good reason: it wants the truth under the surface, found alone, slowly, by turning a question over until it gives something up. Out loud, with other people, chasing whatever flares bright in the room — that's how the truth gets found on the other side of you. Here those two don't cancel. The questions multiply before any one of them gets answered, and you can be halfway down a new thread before the old one closes.
